fact: The aide-memoire of the World Bank mission of 27 October to 14 November 2025 states that under subcomponent 2.4 (Health Management Information Systems, implemented by WHO) of the IDA-grant-financed Health Sector Transformation Project, procurement of laptops, printers and other data collection, reporting and storage equipment has begun for selected county and state hospitals with delivery expected in January 2026, that selection of high-volume PHCCs for digitalisation of data collection with computers is ongoing, and that DHIS2 reporting rates among project-supported facilities are above 85%.
title: South Sudan Health Sector Transformation Project (HSTP) (P181385): World Bank Implementation Support and Mid-Term Review Mission, October 27 - November 14, 2025
